rule: Every checker must reject each file with an issue at `path` (JSON Pointer; it may report more): parseBuiltModel (viewer: "throws" = ModelError; "warns" = console.warn and the furniture leniency of DESIGN.md 5.6), ajv (schema cases) and walkthrough_api.builtmodel.validate (the API rejects every file, the furniture cases included). A missing property is reported at its parent object (as ajv and jsonschema do); a duplicate at its later occurrence.
v2Base: the same model with stairways [S1: L1 to L2], a tread and a landing of S1 (the last two parts), spaces [L1-R1, L2-R1] and the first drawn name of L1 in L1-R1 (the v2-* cases; docs/rooms/DESIGN.md R-12.1)

schema/missing-field.json.fault: floors[1] has no wallHeight (a missing property is reported at its parent object)

cross/unknown-floor.json.fault: parts[10] is on floor "L9", which the model does not have

cross/duplicate-opening-id.json.fault: openings[5] repeats the id of openings[4] (the later occurrence is reported)

cross/stair-6-numbers.json.fault: stairs.L1.below has 6 numbers (not a multiple of 4)

cross/furniture-unknown-kind.json.fault: furniture[0].kind "spaceship" is not in furnitureKinds (its old kind's count is lowered by one, so the counts still agree)

cross/furniture-count.json.fault: furnitureKinds[0].count is one more than its pieces

schema/v2-walk-one-point.json.fault: stairways[0].walk has one point (a walking line has at least 2)

cross/v2-stairway-unknown-floor.json.fault: stairways[0].to is "L9", which the model does not have

cross/v2-stairway-not-above.json.fault: stairways[0].to is its own from floor (to must be above from)

cross/v2-stairway-other-stack.json.fault: floors[1] is in another stack ("annex"): stairways[0] would leave its stack

cross/v2-duplicate-stairway-id.json.fault: stairways[1] repeats the id of stairways[0] (the later occurrence is reported)

cross/v2-part-unknown-stairway.json.fault: parts[124] (a tread) names the stairway "S9", which the model does not have

cross/v2-part-stair-on-another-floor.jso.fault: parts[124] (a tread of S1, which rises from L1) is on L2

cross/v2-tread-without-stair.json.fault: parts[125] (a landing) names no stairway (a missing property is reported at its parent object)

cross/v2-duplicate-space-id.json.fault: spaces[1] repeats the id of spaces[0] (the later occurrence is reported)

cross/v2-space-unknown-floor.json.fault: spaces[1] is on floor "L9", which the model does not have

cross/v2-room-space-on-another-floor.jso.fault: rooms[0] (a name on L1) names a space of L2
